title: An invitation with a countdown
blurb: A pretty page for your party or event, counting down the days, with a form so people can say if they are coming.
best_for: Birthdays, weddings, a housewarming, a reunion, a club night, a leaving do.

asks.label: Where is it?
asks.placeholder: 12 Oak Lane, Smalltown — the house with the red door

asks.label: A message for your guests
asks.placeholder: Come for food, cake and far too much talking. Bring nothing but yourself — and maybe a jumper, we will be in the garden.
asks.default: Come and celebrate with us. There will be food, drinks and good company.

changing: Every word of the invitation is in web/index.html - open it, change the text, save, and refresh the page.
The date and time are set near the top of start.py, on the lines that say WHEN_DATE and WHEN_TIME.
Guest replies are saved in data/rsvp.csv, and you can see them on the page called guests.html.
The colour is the first line of web/style.css.

map.run.bat: double-click to start it on Windows
map.run.sh: double-click to start it on macOS or Linux
map.start.py: the date, the countdown and the replies
map.serve.py: the engine (you never need to open this)
map.web/guests.html: the page listing who is coming
